استنفروا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْفَرُوا (istanfarū) /is.tan.fa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَنْفَرَ (istanfara)
# اُسْتُنْفِرُوا (ustunfirū) /us.tun.fi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْفَرَ (istanfara)
# اِسْتَنْفِرُوا (istanfirū) /is.tan.fi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْفَرَ (istanfara)
